question:
The RBI revamped the Kisan Credit Card (KCC) scheme framework for all banks in June 2026. 

Which of the following provisions is completely accurate as per the revised guidelines?

options.A: The revised KCC directions will apply to all loans sanctioned under the scheme starting immediately from July 1, 2026.
options.B: Marginal farmers (landholding up to 1 hectare) are eligible for a flexible credit limit of Rs 50,000 to Rs 1,00,000 as Flexi KCC.
options.C: The term-loan component of the KCC shall be repayable within a maximum period of 6 years depending on the type of activity.
options.D: Loans with a tenure exceeding 6 years will be integrated as a core component within the KCC limit.
options.E: Short duration crops under standard crop seasons are strictly capped at 9 months.

rationale: Option C is correct. The term-loan component is repayable within 6 years. Exceptions (>6 years) are treated as a separate facility outside KCC (making D incorrect). The rules apply from Jan 1, 2027 (making A incorrect). The Flexi KCC limit for marginal farmers is Rs 10,000 to Rs 50,000 (making B incorrect). Short duration crops are 12 months (making E incorrect). (Refer Page 25, 60)

options.B: Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A.
